description: Draggable chip representing a pivot field placed in a Row, Column, Value, or Filter area of a pivot table. Shows the field title and, for row/column areas, a sort indicator and a menu for changing sort direction; supports drag-and-drop reordering between areas.

parameters.name: AllowDragDrop
parameters.description: Whether the chip can be dragged.

parameters.name: Area
parameters.description: The area where this chip is currently placed.

parameters.name: OnRemoveClick
parameters.description: Fires when remove button is clicked.

parameters.name: OnSettingsClick
parameters.description: Fires when settings button is clicked.

parameters.name: OnSortChanged
parameters.description: Fires when sort direction or criterion changes.

parameters.name: ShowRemove
parameters.description: Whether to show the remove button.

parameters.name: ShowSettings
parameters.description: Whether to show the settings button.

parameters.name: ShowSortMenu
parameters.description: Whether to show the sort menu button.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: Current sort criterion displayed on the chip.

parameters.name: SortDirection
parameters.description: Current sort direction displayed on the chip.
